_meta.source: Harvested live from Football Manager 26's own Tactics Planner > Player Roles UI (PlayerInstructionRoleEditCard), via the FMBridge WebSocket automation bridge driving the running game.
_meta.method: For each position group, one XI player's role picker was opened from the Tactics Planner table; each candidate role card was selected (browse-only, never applied/confirmed) and its right-hand detail panel (role name, description, Key Attributes list) was read directly from the UI Toolkit visual tree.
_meta.fidelity_note: Only role_name, description, and the NAMES of attributes the game highlights under 'Key Attributes' are role-intrinsic and recorded here. The game does not expose a separate 'preferable attributes' tier - only one 'Key Attributes' list is shown, so that field is explicitly marked missing rather than inferred. Numeric attribute VALUES and the word suitability rating (e.g. 'Excellent') shown alongside each role are specific to whichever player's role card was open at harvest time, NOT role-intrinsic, and are deliberately excluded from this file.
_meta.truncation_note: Some descriptions are cut off mid-sentence at exactly 240 characters. This is a hard cap in the bridge's text-extraction code (ExtractOwnText in Navigator.cs), not a game-side or transcription limit. Affected roles carry a 'description_note' field.
_meta.coverage_caveat: Position groups NOT harvested at all: M (C) and D/WB (L) (wing-back), both only present on the bench (substitutes) in the tactic used for harvesting. Bench players' role-edit card could not be opened via the same Tactics Planner table click path used for the starting XI (the click executed but no PlayerInstructionRoleEditCard opened - nav_history and on-screen state were unaffected), and switching a bench player into the XI to reach it was avoided because it would have required changing the tactic, which was disallowed. Within ST (C), a 6th role 'False Nine' is confirmed to exist (visible in the role list, name read directly from the game) but sits below the scrollable role-picker's visible viewport; the bridge has no scroll/keyboard-navigation verb to bring it into view, so its description and key attributes could not be read and are marked missing below rather than guessed. Every other role in every harvested position group (3 roles for GK, 4 for D(C), 5 each for D(R)/D(L)/DM/AM(R)/AM(C)/AM(L), 6 for ST(C) including the name-only False Nine) was accounted for - no roles were silently dropped.
